body:
_Verify the system can protect against aggregate or continuous access of secured functions, resources, or data. For example, consider the use of a resource governor to limit the number of edits per hour or to prevent the entire database from being scraped by an individual user._

Perhaps: 
Confirm that the application makes use of underlying system and logical resource limits. For example, application alerts on unique logins form the same IP address; or unique login failures from the same IP address. 

This should refer user to AppSensor project.
